subject.title: fix(tts): allow trusted local media in message_tool_only mode

question: Should `message_tool_only` allow internally trusted local media to bypass source suppression as stripped media-only content, or should this PR narrow the bypass to TTS/tool-media provenance only?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but the permanent trust boundary for suppressed channel delivery is a maintainer policy choice because a too-broad marker could deliver media that users expected to remain private.

options.title: Accept trustedLocalMedia boundary
options.body: Land this PR with the current checks: `message_tool_only`, actual media, internal trusted marker, text stripping, and untrusted media suppression.

options.title: Require TTS-only provenance
options.body: Ask for a narrow patch that keys the bypass to TTS/tool-media provenance instead of all `trustedLocalMedia` payloads.

options.title: Reject automatic media bypass
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep the linked issue open for a design where media must be delivered through the message tool contract.

recommendation.title: Accept trustedLocalMedia boundary
recommendation.body: Land this PR with the current checks: `message_tool_only`, actual media, internal trusted marker, text stripping, and untrusted media suppression.
